description: This file defines the 'TaxesAndTotals' class within the 'erpnext' namespace, extending 'erpnext.payments'. It manages calculations related to taxes, discounts, shipping, and totals for invoices and other financial documents in the ERPNext system.

classes.name: TaxesAndTotals
classes.description: A class for handling tax and total calculations in ERPNext, including discounts, shipping, taxes, and grand total computations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the object and fetches round-off accounts.

methods.name: apply_pricing_rule_on_item
methods.description: Applies pricing rules, including margins and discounts, to an item.

methods.name: calculate_taxes_and_totals
methods.description: Main method to calculate taxes, discounts, shipping, and totals, with options for updating paid amounts.

methods.name: calculate_discount_amount
methods.description: Calculates the discount amount based on the discount percentage.

methods.name: _calculate_taxes_and_totals
methods.description: Performs detailed calculations for taxes and totals, including validation and item value calculations.

methods.name: validate_conversion_rate
methods.description: Ensures the conversion rate is valid and sets it if missing.

methods.name: calculate_item_values
methods.description: Calculates net amounts, weights, and base currency values for items.

methods.name: set_in_company_currency
methods.description: Converts specified fields of a document to company currency based on conversion rate.

methods.name: initialize_taxes
methods.description: Initializes tax objects, resetting relevant fields.

methods.name: fetch_round_off_accounts
methods.description: Fetches applicable accounts for rounding off adjustments.

methods.name: determine_exclusive_rate
methods.description: Calculates item net amounts for inclusive taxes to determine exclusive rates.

methods.name: get_current_tax_fraction
methods.description: Calculates the current tax fraction for inclusive tax calculations.

methods.name: _get_tax_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the applicable tax rate for a given tax and item tax map.

methods.name: calculate_net_total
methods.description: Calculates total, net total, and base net total for items.

methods.name: calculate_shipping_charges
methods.description: Calculates shipping charges and totals.

methods.name: add_taxes_from_item_tax_template
methods.description: Adds taxes from an item tax template if applicable.

methods.name: calculate_taxes
methods.description: Calculates individual tax amounts, including handling of different charge types and inclusive taxes.

methods.name: set_cumulative_total
methods.description: Sets cumulative total for taxes based on item index.

methods.name: _load_item_tax_rate
methods.description: Parses item tax rate JSON string into an object.

methods.name: get_current_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates the current tax amount for an item based on tax charge type.

methods.name: set_item_wise_tax
methods.description: Stores item-wise tax breakup details.

methods.name: round_off_totals
methods.description: Rounds off tax amounts if applicable.

methods.name: round_off_base_values
methods.description: Rounds off base tax amounts if applicable.

methods.name: manipulate_grand_total_for_inclusive_tax
methods.description: Adjusts grand total for inclusive taxes to match total with inclusive tax considerations.

methods.name: calculate_totals
methods.description: Calculates overall totals, including grand total, base grand total, and taxes and charges.

methods.name: set_rounded_total
methods.description: Sets the rounded total based on currency smallest fraction.

methods.name: _cleanup
methods.description: Cleans temporary fields and prepares data for final output.

methods.name: set_discount_amount
methods.description: Sets discount amount based on discount percentage.

methods.name: apply_discount_amount
methods.description: Applies discount amount proportionally to items.

methods.name: get_total_for_discount_amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount to base discount on, considering taxes.

methods.name: calculate_total_advance
methods.description: Calculates total advance paid and updates outstanding amount.

methods.name: is_internal_invoice
methods.description: Checks if the invoice is an internal invoice.

methods.name: calculate_outstanding_amount
methods.description: Calculates the outstanding amount to be paid.

methods.name: set_total_amount_to_default_mop
methods.description: Sets default total amount for the main mode of payment.

methods.name: set_default_payment
methods.description: Sets default payment amount in the payment entries.

methods.name: calculate_paid_amount
methods.description: Calculates total paid amount and base paid amount.

methods.name: calculate_change_amount
methods.description: Calculates change amount for cash payments.

methods.name: calculate_write_off_amount
methods.description: Calculates write-off amount if paid amount exceeds grand total.
